name: @memrov2/pentcloud-recon
description: A small Cloudflare-native runtime for httpx, dnsx, Katana and Subfinder

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run test:runner && npm run test:image && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --config examples/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc .cache/worker-types.d.ts && tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 .cache/worker-types.d.ts test/types.ts
